arxiv-1311-6934.title: Image forgery detection based on the fusion of machine learning and block-matching methods
arxiv-1311-6934.creator: Davide Cozzolino, Diego Gragnaniello, Luisa Verdoliva
arxiv-1311-6934.description: Abstract Dense local descriptors and machine learning have been used with success in several applications, like classification of textures, steganalysis, and forgery detection. We develop a new image forgery detector building upon some descriptors recently proposed in the steganalysis field suitably merging some of such descriptors, and optimizing a SVM classifier on the available training set.

arxiv-2102-11126.title: Deepfake Video Detection Using Convolutional Vision Transformer
arxiv-2102-11126.creator: Deressa Wodajo, Solomon Atnafu
arxiv-2102-11126.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of deep learning models that can generate and synthesis hyper-realistic videos known as Deepfakes and their ease of access have raised concern on possible malicious intent use. Deep learning techniques can now generate faces, swap faces between two subjects in a video, alter facial expressions, change gender, and alter facial features, to list a few.

arxiv-2204-00536.title: Semi-FairVAE: Semi-supervised Fair Representation Learning with Adversarial Variational Autoencoder Price: 15.00
arxiv-2204-00536.creator: Chuhan Wu 1 , Fangzhao Wu 2 , Tao Qi 1 , Yongfeng Huang 1
arxiv-2204-00536.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Chuhan Wu 1 , Fangzhao Wu 2 , Tao Qi 1 , Yongfeng Huang 1. Adversarial learning is a widely used technique in fair representation learning to remove the biases on sensitive attributes from data representations. It usually requires incorporating the sensitive attribute labels as prediction targets.

arxiv-2305-02422.title: GAMIVAL: Video Quality Prediction on Mobile Cloud Gaming Content
arxiv-2305-02422.creator: Yu-Chih Chen, Avinab Saha, Chase Davis, Bo Qiu, Xiaoming Wang, Rahul Gowda, Ioannis Katsavounidis, and Alan C. Bovik
arxiv-2305-02422.description: Abstract The mobile cloud gaming industry has been rapidly growing over the last decade. When streaming gaming videos are transmitted to customers’ client devices from cloud servers, algorithms that can monitor distorted video quality without having any reference video available are desirable tools.

arxiv-2307-10801.title: Bardeen spacetime as a quantum corrected Schwarzschild black hole: Quasinormal modes and Hawking radiation
arxiv-2307-10801.creator: R. A. Konoplya, D. Ovchinnikov, B. Ahmedov
arxiv-2307-10801.description: Abstract The Bardeen black hole holds historical significance as the first model of a regular black hole. Recently, there have been proposed interpretations of the Bardeen spacetime as quantum corrections to the Schwarzschild solution. Our study focuses on investigating the quasinormal modes and Hawking radiation of the Bardeen black hole.

arxiv-2312-15637.title: Thermal Relic Right-Handed Neutrino Dark Matter
arxiv-2312-15637.creator: Jie Sheng, Yu Cheng, Tsutomu T. Yanagida
arxiv-2312-15637.description: Abstract It is known that two heavy Majorana right-handed neutrinos are sufficient to generate the baryon asymmetry in the present universe. Thus, it is interesting to identify the third right-handed neutrino N N with the dark matter. We impose a new discrete symmetry Z 2 Z_{2} on this dark matter neutrino to stabilize it.

arxiv-2402-14678.title: Zeptonewton and Attotesla per Centimeter Metrology With Coupled Oscillators
arxiv-2402-14678.creator: Ian Bouche, Josh Javor, Abhishek Som, David K. Campbell, David J. Bishop
arxiv-2402-14678.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ian Bouche, Josh Javor, Abhishek Som, David K. Campbell, David J. Bishop. We present the coupled oscillator: a new mechanism for signal amplification with widespread application in metrology. We introduce the mechanical theory of this framework, and support it by way of simulations.

arxiv-2403-04656.title: Chain of Thought Explanation for Dialogue State Tracking
arxiv-2403-04656.creator: Lin Xu, Ningxin Peng, Daquan Zhou, See-Kiong Ng, Jinlan Fu
arxiv-2403-04656.description: Abstract Dialogue state tracking (DST) aims to record user queries and goals during a conversational interaction achieved by maintaining a predefined set of slots and their corresponding values. Current approaches decide slot values opaquely, while humans usually adopt a more deliberate approach by collecting information from relevant dialogue turns and then reasoning the appropriate values.

arxiv-2406-04617.title: JWST view of four infant galaxies at z = 8.31 z=8.31 –8.49 in the MACS0416 field and implications for reionization
arxiv-2406-04617.creator: Zhiyuan Ma, Bangzheng Sun, Cheng Cheng, Haojing Yan, Chenxiaoji Ling, Fengwu Sun, Nicholas Foo, Eiichi Egami, José M. Diego, Seth H. Cohen, Rolf A. Jansen, Jake Summers, Rogier A. Windhorst, Jordan C. J. D’Silva, Anton M. Koekemoer, Dan Coe, Christopher J. Conselice, Simon P. Driver, Brenda Frye, No
arxiv-2406-04617.description: Abstract New JWST/NIRCam wide-field slitless spectroscopy provides redshifts for four z > 8 z>8 galaxies located behind the lensing cluster MACS J0416.1 − - 2403. Two of them, “Y1” and “JD”, have previously reported spectroscopic redshifts based on ALMA measurements of [O III] 88 μ \mu m and/or [C II] 157.7 μ \mu m lines.

arxiv-2407-02302.title: Towards Human Understanding of Paraphrase Types in Large Language Models
arxiv-2407-02302.creator: Dominik Meier, Jan Philip Wahle, Terry Ruas, Bela Gipp
arxiv-2407-02302.description: Abstract Paraphrases represent a human’s intuitive ability to understand expressions presented in various different ways. Current paraphrase evaluations of language models primarily use binary approaches, offering limited interpretability of specific text changes. Atomic paraphrase types (APT) decompose paraphrases into different linguistic changes and offer a granular view of the flexibility in linguistic expression (e.g.

arxiv-2408-05429.title: Testing Bell inequalities and probing quantum entanglement at a muon collider
arxiv-2408-05429.creator: Alim Ruzi, Youpeng Wu, Ran Ding, Sitian Qian, Andrew Micheal Levin, Qiang Li
arxiv-2408-05429.description: Abstract A muon collider represents a promising candidate for the next generation of particle physics experiments after the expected end of LHC operations in the early 2040s. Rare or hard-to-detect processes at the LHC, such as the production of multiple gauge bosons, become accessible at a TeV muon collider.

arxiv-2503-08738.title: Shedding Light on Task Decomposition in Program Synthesis: The Driving Force of the Synthesizer Model
arxiv-2503-08738.creator: Janis Zenkner, Tobias Sesterhenn, Christian Bartelt
arxiv-2503-08738.description: Abstract Task decomposition is a fundamental mechanism in program synthesis, enabling complex problems to be broken down into manageable subtasks. ExeDec, a state-of-the-art program synthesis framework, employs this approach by combining a Subgoal Model for decomposition and a Synthesizer Model for program generation to facilitate compositional generalization.

arxiv-2503-15071.title: Instability of the peaked traveling wave in a local model for shallow water waves
arxiv-2503-15071.creator: Fábio Natali, Dmitry E. Pelinovsky, Shuoyang Wang
arxiv-2503-15071.description: Abstract . The traveling wave with the peaked profile arises in the limit of the family of traveling waves with the smooth profiles. We study the linear and nonlinear stability of the peaked traveling wave by using a local model for shallow water waves, which is related to the Hunter–Saxton equation.

arxiv-2510-00842.title: Monotonicity of the Gaussian measure under Banaszczyk transforms
arxiv-2510-00842.creator: Maud Szusterman
arxiv-2510-00842.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maud Szusterman. In the proof of his famous 5 ​ K 5K -theorem, W. Banaszczyk introduced a transformation of convex bodies for which the Gaussian measure is monotone. In this note, we present a simplified proof of this monotonicity by slightly modifying Banaszczyk’s transform, so that it interacts smoothly with Ehrhard symmetrizations, thereby yielding a somewhat easier proof of the 5 ​ K 5K -theorem.

arxiv-2511-00713.title: Lexical tableaux and quasisymmetric functions
arxiv-2511-00713.creator: John M. Campbell, Spencer Daugherty
arxiv-2511-00713.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by John M. Campbell, Spencer Daugherty. There is a natural bijection between standard immaculate tableaux of composition shape α ⊨ n \alpha\vDash n and length ℓ ⁡ ( α ) = k \ell(\alpha)=k and the { n k } \left\{\begin{smallmatrix}n\\ k\end{smallmatrix}\right\} set-partitions of { 1 , 2 , … , n } \{1,2,\ldots,n\} into k k blocks, for the Stirling number { n k } \left\{\begin{smallmatrix}n\\ k\end{smallmatrix}\right\} of the second kind.

arxiv-2602-16704.title: Reinforced Fast Weights with Next-Sequence Prediction
arxiv-2602-16704.creator: Hee Seung Hwang, Xindi Wu, Sanghyuk Chun, Olga Russakovsky
arxiv-2602-16704.description: Abstract Fast weight architectures offer a promising alternative to attention-based transformers for long-context modeling by maintaining constant memory overhead regardless of context length. However, their potential is limited by the next-token prediction (NTP) training paradigm. NTP optimizes single-token predictions and ignores semantic coherence across multiple tokens following a prefix.

arxiv-2603-22504.title: Tied In on TikTok: Tie Strength and Emotional Dynamics in Algorithmic Communities
arxiv-2603-22504.creator: Charles Bickham, Minh Duc Chu, Arianna Yuan, Valerie Lookingbill, Ehsan Mohammadi, Stuart Murray, Kristina Lerman, Emilio Ferrara

europmc-pmc3376616.creator: Li YH, Tian X.
europmc-pmc3376616.description: Many bacteria are known to regulate their cooperative activities and physiological processes through a mechanism called quorum sensing (QS), in which bacterial cells communicate with each other by releasing, sensing and responding to small diffusible signal molecules. The...

pmc-10747574.title: Nano-Based Drug Delivery Systems: Potential Developments in the Therapy of Metastatic Osteosarcoma—A Narrative Review
pmc-10747574.creator: Yuanrui Luo, Minghao Sun, Linyun Tan, Tao Li, Li Min, Avi Domb, Alyssa Panitch
pmc-10747574.description: Osteosarcoma, a predominant malignant bone tumor, poses significant challenges due to its high metastatic and recurrent nature. Although various therapeutic strategies are currently in use, they often inadequately target osteosarcoma metastasis. This review focuses on the potential of nanoscale drug delivery systems to bridge this clinical gap.

pmc-11332636.title: Genomic context determines the effect of DNA methylation on gene expression in the gut epithelium of Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar)
pmc-11332636.creator: Aikaterini Katirtzoglou, Søren B. Hansen, Harald Sveier, Michael D. Martin, Jaelle C. Brealey, Morten T. Limborg
pmc-11332636.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The canonical view of DNA methylation, a pivotal epigenetic regulation mechanism in eukaryotes, dictates its role as a suppressor of gene activity, particularly within promoter regions. However, this view is being challenged as it is becoming increasingly evident that the connection between DNA methylation and gene expression varies depending on the genomic location and is therefore more complex than initially thought.

pmc-11402740.title: Analysis of risk factors for papillary thyroid carcinoma and the association with thyroid function indicators
pmc-11402740.creator: Jianning Liu, Zhuoying Feng, Ru Gao, Peng Liu, Fangang Meng, Lijun Fan, Lixiang Liu, Yang Du
pmc-11402740.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to analyze the relationship between papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) and various factors.MethodsThe study involved two groups—PTC patients and non-PTC controls. We utilized binary logistic regression and Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (Lasso) regression for variable selection and risk factor analysis. Correlation analysis was performed using Spearman’s rank correlation.

pmc-11590968.title: Curcumin’s Radioprotective Effects on Zebrafish Embryos
pmc-11590968.creator: Gaia Pucci, Gaetano Savoca, Giuseppina Iacoviello, Giorgio Russo, Giusi I. Forte, Vincenzo Cavalieri
pmc-11590968.description: Radiation modifiers are largely studied for their contribution to enlarging the treatment window. Curcumin is already known for its antioxidant properties; however, its role as a radioprotector in preclinical studies is affected by the well-known low absorption and bioavailability of curcumin.

pmc-11811775.title: Establishment and evaluation of a UPLC-MS/MS method for simultaneous determination of bongkrekic acid and dehydroacetic acid in rice noodles
pmc-11811775.creator: Lingguo Zhao, Ronggui Lv, Jiang Song, Xi Chen, Lei Lei, Weixian Zeng, Miaowen She, Dabing Li, Xiaxia Yu, Zhanguo Liu, Xiao Wang, Yong Liu
pmc-11811775.description: A UPLC-MS/MS method with one-step extraction and simultaneous determination of bongkrekic acid (BA) and dehydroacetic acid (DHA) in rice noodles has been established in this study for the first time. The extraction solvent consisted of a mixture of methanol, ammonia, and water.

pmc-12755092.title: Enablement After Consultation in Primary Healthcare: How Do Patients and Doctors Cross-Sectionally Evaluate It in Northern Portugal
pmc-12755092.creator: Isabel Inês Loureiro, Andreia Teixeira, Mariana Fleming Torrinha, Luiz Miguel Santiago, Sofia Baptista
pmc-12755092.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionThe degree to which patients are able to understand, cope with, and manage their illness and daily lives can be assessed using the Patient Enablement Instrument (PEI) questionnaire, a tool widely recognized as the gold standard for such evaluations.

pmc-12966979.title: Teleosts as Models for Epigenetic Inheritance
pmc-12966979.creator: Adauto Lima Cardoso, Ozren Bogdanovic
pmc-12966979.description: Teleost fish exhibit a striking divergence from mammals in how they regulate their epigenome. Unlike mammals, they do not undergo the extensive DNA methylation erasure and resetting events that occur during early embryogenesis, germline specification, and spermatogenesis. Consequently, DNA methylation patterns in teleosts might persist across generations, making these species potentially valuable models for studying intergenerational and transgenerational epigenetic inheritance.

pmc-13017454.title: Expedited transfer to emergency department vs. cardiac catheter laboratory in a cardiac arrest centre for non-ST-elevation out-of-hospital cardiac arrest: ARREST trial as-treated analysis
pmc-13017454.creator: Tiffany Patterson, Gavin D Perkins, Matthew Dodd, Alexander Perkins, Adam Mellett-Smith, Rachael T Fothergill, Tim Clayton, Richard Evans, Steven Robertson, Matthew Kwok, Karen Wilson, Benedict McDonaugh, Paul McCrone, Miles Dalby, Sam Firoozi, Iqbal Malik, Roby Rakhit, Ajay Jain, Philip MacCarthy,
pmc-13017454.description: AimsThe ARREST trial demonstrated that in adult patients, transfer to a cardiac catheter laboratory in a cardiac arrest centre (CAC) following resuscitated out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) without ST-elevation did not reduce deaths at 30 days compared with delivery to the geographically closest emergency department (standard care).

pmc-13089224.title: Integrating co-expression network analysis and machine learning to reveal the regulatory landscape of GPD genes in Chlamydomonas reinhardtii under salinity stress
pmc-13089224.creator: Jorge A. Tzec-Interian, Santy Peraza-Echeverria, Virginia Aurora Herrera-Valencia, Elsa B. Gongora-Castillo
pmc-13089224.description: BackgroundSalinity stress imposes major constraints on cellular homeostasis. In Chlamydomonas reinhardtii, glycerol biosynthesis is a key osmoprotective response mediated by glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenases (GPDs). Although GPD2 and GPD3 genes are known to be salt-responsive with high sequence identity and shared metabolic roles, the regulatory mechanisms of their differential expression have remained unclear.

pmc-13149612.title: Safety and efficacy of percutaneous nephrolithotomy in elderly patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis by the EAU-YAU urolithiasis and EAU endourology sections
pmc-13149612.creator: Łukasz Nowak, Begoña Ballesta Martinez, Wojciech Krajewski, Bhaskar Somani, Amelia Pietropaolo, Wojciech Tomczak, Jan Łaszkiewicz, Matthias Boeykens, Thomas Tailly, Theodoros Spinos, Alberto Olivero, Arman Tsaturyan, Patrick JuliebØ-Jones, Senol Tonyali, Agata Góral, Paulina Biesiadecka, Adam Chełmo
pmc-13149612.description: PurposeThe aim of this study was to evaluate differences in safety and efficacy outcomes of PCNL between elderly and non-elderly patients, with special focus on commonly applied age cut-off values.MethodsA systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines.

pmc-13567205.title: Assessment of Nutritional Risk Representations in Publicly Available Data in Saudi Arabia: A Triangulated Scoping Study
pmc-13567205.creator: Reham I. Alagal
pmc-13567205.description: Background: Saudi Arabia maintains official statistics on its food security, in addition to conducting surveys on health parameters and performing national health assessments. Also, several academic papers on dietary patterns are published every year. Many published documents analyze data on food availability, self-reported eating habits, and biomarker-based health risks. However, individually, they represent distinct aspects of nutrition.

pmc-13599604.title: Physician Experiences and Prescribing Preferences for Targeted B-complex and Vitamin C Supplementation in Daily Clinical Practice: A National KAP Survey in India
pmc-13599604.creator: Vikas Oswal, Vinay Purohit, Poonam Shah
pmc-13599604.description: BackgroundWater-soluble vitamins, particularly B-complex vitamins and vitamin C, play essential roles in energy metabolism, immune function, and tissue repair. Despite widespread clinical use, variability in evidence across indications and prescribing practices necessitates evaluation of physician perspectives. This study aimed to assess knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) of clinicians regarding Becozym C Forte® in routine clinical settings.
